# BreezyAir

> BreezyAir is Bengaluru's trusted HVAC service provider offering same-day AC repair, deep cleaning, maintenance plans, and new installations. Same technician every time. No hidden costs. Serving Indiranagar, Koramangala, Whitefield, HSR Layout, Marathahalli, and all of Bengaluru.

## Services

- [AC Repair](https://breezyair.co/services) — Same-day diagnosis and repair for all AC brands. Starts at ₹499.
- [AC Deep Cleaning](https://breezyair.co/services) — High-pressure jet wash, anti-bacterial foam, coil and fin deep clean. Starts at ₹899.
- [AC Installation](https://breezyair.co/services) — Split and window AC installation with full handover. Flat ₹1,499.
- [AMC Plans](https://breezyair.co/pricing) — Annual maintenance contracts with priority booking and parts discounts.
- [Inspection Visit](https://breezyair.co/services) — 10-minute on-site diagnosis with written quote. ₹350, waived if you approve the work.

## About

Breezyair is a neighborhood HVAC service run by Asad Khan, an industry-certified and background-verified technician based in Indiranagar, Bengaluru. Asad personally handles every job — same technician every time. Services include AC repair, wet deep cleaning, filter service, capacitor checks, gas top-up, installation, and uninstallation. Transparent pricing with WhatsApp invoice. 500+ homes serviced across Bengaluru.
